description: Full token / contract due-diligence report (risk score + AI analyst write-up). One call, full due diligence on an ERC20 on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum or Optimism before you buy, list, accept or integrate it. Combines: honeypot/tax/mint/blacklist/hidden-owner scan with 0-100 risk score; owner & creator holdings and whether ownership can be reclaimed; proxy/upgradeability and implementation; source verification (Sourcify) and privileged admin functions found in the ABI (mint, pause, blacklist, setFee, upgradeTo…); top-10 holders with locked/contract tags; DEX pools with USD liquidity and % of LP locked; USD price and approx market cap; recent on-chain transfer activity. Then an AI analyst write-up: verdict (avoid/caution/acceptable), key risks ranked, green flags, and what to verify next. Facts and write-up are both returned so you can audit the reasoning. Not charged if the token can't be analyzed. Free sample: /v1/free/token-report.
